description: We are a team under The Summit Society (TSS), bringing together curious minds from different fields to explore complex global and scientific challenges. We combine research, technology, creativity, and interdisciplinary thinking to turn unconventional ideas into meaningful solutions.
summary: Luma Sphere is a web app for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 challenge “Planet X and SPHEREx.” It lets you stand inside the sky and look around NASA’s SPHEREx all-sky infrared map. You can choose any of its 102 wavelengths, from 0.75 to 5.0 µm, then search for a star, planet, asteroid, comet or galaxy and fly the view there. A proper-motion correction places fast movers like Barnard’s Star at their mid-survey positions. The planned time-lapse feature will blink through the survey epochs to reveal changing sources, which is the challenge’s core requirement. The goal is to make a dense archive explorable by anyone, including people hunting for faint, moving objects such as cold brown dwarfs.
